item.title: Dual Investment: Where the Yield Comes From—and Who Bears the Risk
item.description:
“If the price goes up, you earn USDT. If it goes down, you earn more crypto.”

It sounds as though you come out ahead whichever way the market moves. Add an advertised annualized return of several dozen percent—or more—and dual investment can look like a more productive alternative to simply holding crypto.

But there is a catch: owning more units of an asset does not necessarily mean your investment is worth more.

item.title: Options 101: The Four Basic Positions Explained Through Gold
item.description:
When you first encounter options, four terms come up again and again:

Buy a call. Sell a call. Buy a put. Sell a put.

These are not four unrelated strategies. They are combinations of two choices:

  • Are you trading a call or a put?
  • Are you buying it or selling it?

To understand these four basic positions, start with one idea: an option gives its buyer a right to transact in the future. Trading that right is different from buying or selling the asset itself.
